# miniaudio/

Single-header audio I/O library (capture, playback, full-duplex, device
enumeration). Upstream: <https://github.com/mackron/miniaudio>

Fetched automatically by CMake `FetchContent` (tag `0.11.25`). To vendor a copy
instead, drop `miniaudio.h` (and `extras/` if needed) into this directory and
configure with `-DFLUXVOICE_FETCH_DEPS=OFF`.
